analysis: sky v1, pre-registered questions 7 and 8 (grokking-v1), with Amendment 1 items F and G

items.question: Q7 (registered) + Amendment F.1/F.3: at configurations whose seeds disagree, is the fraction of runs with a strong activation (peak >= 0.02 nats) after the training set is fitted higher in grokking seeds than in the other seeds (bootstrap CI above 0)?
items.definition_used: Per run: has >= 1 event of kind activation or reactivation with peak_ri >= 0.02 nats and step_lo >= t_train_acc99 (onset bracket (step_lo, step] entirely after the first light-curve evaluation with train acc >= 0.99; left-censored onsets have step_lo = 0 and never qualify). Events from the DR1 ri_events table (follow-up replay, alpha 0.01, min_effect 0.005, persistence 2), cross-checked against detect_events(curve, alpha=0.01) on all 689 curves. Configuration = (p, train_frac, width, lr, wd). Comparison set = every configuration whose seeds include 'grokking' and >= 1 other label (all its seeds; the registered 'configurations whose seeds disagree' restricted to those that contain a grokking seed, since only they allow a grokking-vs-control contrast). Statistic: pooled fraction in grokking seeds minus pooled fraction in the other seeds; 95 % percentile CI from 2,000 bootstrap resamples of configurations (seed 20261112). Alternatives reported: activation-only events (v0's exact code, which reproduces v0's 85/137 = 62 % and 81/137 = 59 % on DR0), and the mean over configurations of the per-configuration difference. Literal verdict: supported iff CI lower bound > 0, else 'not supported (property of the label-selected sample)'. Amended (F.3, decides): CI above 0 supported, below 0 not supported, including 0 with few (< 10) configurations inconclusive.
items.literal_result: 9 configurations ([256] width), 63 runs: grokking 23/32 (71.9 %) vs other seeds 20/31 (64.5 %); difference +7.4 pp, 95 % CI [-10.1, +21.5] pp. CI not above 0 -> literal reading: not supported (the registered text calls this 'a property of the label-selected sample'). Activation-only: 21/32 vs 17/31, +10.8 pp, CI [-13.9, +32.6] pp.
items.amended_result: Same numbers; every control is near-grokking: labels {'smooth': 31}, final test accuracy 0.806-0.900 (median 0.878); no memorization seed shares a configuration with a grokking seed (memorization at these 9 configurations: 0 runs). With 9 configurations and a CI including 0 the result is inconclusive (F.3), not evidence that the v0 observation was a property of the label-selected sample. Mean of per-configuration differences +5.9 pp, CI [-20.2, +32.8] pp; activation-only CI [-13.9, +32.6] pp (same verdict: inconclusive).

configurations with grokking + other label: 9 (runs 63: 32 grokking, 31 control)
configurations whose seeds disagree (any labels): 30
grokking with measure: 23/32
controls with measure: 20/31 (labels {'smooth': 31})
pooled diff +7.36 pp, CI95 [-10.1, +21.5] pp
activation-only: 21/32 vs 17/31, diff +10.79 pp, CI95 [-13.9, +32.6] pp
control final test acc min/median/max 0.8064/0.8785/0.8996
items.interpretation: Within a configuration the only contrast available is grokking vs smooth seeds that stopped just short of 90 % test accuracy at 50k steps (the same generalising phase, as Amendment F anticipated). Strong late activations are about as common in those near-grokking controls (65 %) as in the grokking seeds (72 %), and the number of such events per run is similar (1.31 vs 1.39). The CI is wide and spans 0, so by the amended rule the question is inconclusive; the literal rule would call the v0 observation a property of the label-selected sample. Either way v1 gives no evidence that late hidden-unit interactions are specific to grokking seeds.
items.caveats: 9 configurations, 63 runs; grokking:control seeds per configuration 1:6, 5:2, 4:3, 2:5, 1:6, 4:3, 5:2, 4:3, 6:1, so several configurations add a single run to one side. 'Few configurations' is not quantified in Amendment F; with 9 configurations and a CI 32 pp wide it is treated as few (threshold used: < 10). The measure fires on any order-2/3 hidden-unit interaction with peak >= 0.02 after the early fit (median t_train_acc99 236 steps in grokking runs, 455 in smooth runs), so it is not specific to the hidden phase. Only 10 hidden units per run are binarised (plus the 'correct' column, which is in no strong event). 688 of 689 replays have only the 60 log-spaced checkpoints (the dense window needs a detected sharp loss drop, found in 1 object). Every grokking-v1 object was followed up (689/689, replay bit-identical to the stored light curve), so the matched sets are complete.

items.question: Amendment F.2 (confounded by configuration): memorization runs at a grid point adjacent (one knob step in train_frac or weight decay) to a point with grokking runs, matched on width and lr; same measure, CI resampling configuration pairs.
items.definition_used: Primary adjacency: one step in the sorted list of the knob's values present anywhere in grokking-v1 (train_frac 14 values, weight decay 13 values, including refinement midpoints), other knobs equal, the neighbouring point must exist and contain >= 1 memorization run. Alternative: the nearest train_frac (weight decay) value present on the same line (same width, lr and other knob). Sensitivity: adjacency on the registered coarse grid only (tf {0.3,0.4,0.5} x wd {0.1,0.3,1.0}). Unit = (grokking point, memorization point) pair; grokking runs of the grokking point vs memorization runs of the memorization point; pooled-over-pairs difference, 2,000 pair resamples.
items.literal_result: not part of the registered question (added by Amendment 1 F.2)
items.amended_result: Primary: 0 pairs: no memorization point adjacent to a grokking point; comparison not estimable. Alternative (line): 1 pairs (1 grokking points, 1 memorization points; 1 grokking runs, 6 memorization runs): grokking 0/1 vs memorization 1/6 (pooled over pairs), diff -16.7 pp, CI95 [n/a]. Sensitivity (coarse grid): 6 pairs (5 grokking points, 6 memorization points; 30 grokking runs, 41 memorization runs): grokking 30/35 vs memorization 19/41 (pooled over pairs), diff +39.4 pp, CI95 [+29.0, +50.9] pp.
items.key_numbers:
global: 0 pairs: no memorization point adjacent to a grokking point; comparison not estimable
line: 1 pairs (1 grokking points, 1 memorization points; 1 grokking runs, 6 memorization runs): grokking 0/1 vs memorization 1/6 (pooled over pairs), diff -16.7 pp, CI95 [n/a]
coarse: 6 pairs (5 grokking points, 6 memorization points; 30 grokking runs, 41 memorization runs): grokking 30/35 vs memorization 19/41 (pooled over pairs), diff +39.4 pp, CI95 [+29.0, +50.9] pp
items.interpretation: After boundary refinement, grokking points and memorization points are never one knob step apart: on every train_frac and weight-decay line the nearest sampled neighbours of grokking points are smooth or grokking points, except one line (lr 0.001, wd 0.5477, width 256) where train_frac 0.3375-0.3625 was not sampled and a 1-grokking-seed point faces a memorization point. The amended neighbour comparison is therefore not estimable (inconclusive, 0 pairs; 1 pair under the alternative). Only on the coarse registered grid, outside the amendment's definition, do pairs exist; there grokking runs carry the measure far more often than memorization runs, but that contrast is between phases at different configurations and is confounded by configuration.
items.caveats: Confounded by configuration by design; the coarse-grid sensitivity has only 6 pairs (5 grokking points), so its bootstrap CI understates the uncertainty.

items.definition_used: Same per-run measure as q7; all 689 objects were followed up. CIs resample configurations within the label. Differences between labels resample all 101 configurations and are confounded by configuration.

items.interpretation: Across the region the measure is most frequent in grokking runs and least in memorization runs, and it rises steadily with final test accuracy ([0, 0.05): 26/97, [0.05, 0.22): 68/142, [0.22, 0.5): 88/156, [0.5, 0.8): 58/101, [0.8, 0.9): 47/70, [0.9, 1]: 103/123), so the label contrast is largely a contrast in how far runs generalise. Labels sit at different configurations, so this is descriptive only.
items.caveats: Labels are confounded with configuration (train_frac, wd, width, lr). Grokking runs fit the training set earlier (median t_train_acc99 236 vs 455 steps), leaving slightly more RI checkpoints after the fit (median 30 vs 26 of 60).

items.question: Q7 secondary: (a) number of strong late events per run (grokking vs controls at the same configurations), (b) does a strong late activation start before generalisation (step_lo < t_test_acc90) in grokking runs (v0: 59 %)?
items.definition_used: (a) count of qualifying events (activation + reactivation) per run; difference of means per run, configurations resampled. (b) per grokking run: >= 1 qualifying event with t_train_acc99 <= step_lo < t_test_acc90; v0's 59 % used activations only (81/137, reproduced from DR0 with this code); both reported.
items.literal_result: (a) same-configuration set: mean 1.31 events/run in grokking vs 1.39 in controls, diff -0.07, CI95 [-0.38, +0.18]. (b) all 123 grokking runs: 101 (82.1 %) have one before generalisation (act+react); activation-only 88 (71.5 %), v0 81/137 (59.1 %).

(b) act+react before gen: 101/123
(b) activation-only before gen: 88/123
(b) late at all (act+react): 103/123; activation-only 91

items.interpretation: 101 of 123 grokking runs have a strong post-fit interaction that switches on before test accuracy reaches 90 % (activation-only 72 % vs v0's 59 %), but at the same configurations the near-grokking controls show as many such events per run, so the observation does not single out grokking.
items.caveats: t_test_acc90 is never reached by non-grokking runs (censored at 50k), so (b) is only defined for grokking runs; v0 used activations only (its 59 % is reproduced exactly from DR0 by this code), the task's measure also counts reactivations.

items.question: Q8 (registered) + Amendment G: fraction of runs labelled memorization at 50k steps vs v0 at 20k; amended baseline: v0 objects on the v1 grid points, compared point by point.
items.definition_used: Literal: v1 region memorization count / all grokking-v1 runs vs the registered '866 of 2,166' (and the corrected 742 of 2,166 of v0's grokking region). Amended (G, decides): v0 region 'grokking' with p 47, train_frac {0.3,0.4,0.5}, width {64,256}, lr {0.001,0.003}, wd {0.1,0.3,1.0}; v1 runs at the same 36 points (all seeds incl. refinement seeds 5-6; also seeds 0-4 only and the exact v0 seeds). Pool by point: each point's memorization fraction, mean over the points present in both, v1 minus v0, CI from 2,000 resamples of points.
items.literal_result: v1 236/689 (34.3 %) vs registered 866/2,166 (40.0 %); 866 is actually v0's all-region count out of 6855; v0 grokking region 742/2166 (34.3 %). Different grids, so not like for like.

Pooled by point: mean memorization fraction 66.5 % (v0) -> 51.6 % (v1), diff -14.8 pp, CI [-25.9, -4.9] pp; points lower/equal/higher in v1: 8/23/0.

items.question: Q8 paired (Amendment G follow-on): do v0 (20k) and v1 (50k) runs with the same configuration and seed follow the same trajectory up to 20k steps, and if so how many v0 memorization runs became grokking (v1 t_test_acc90 > 20,000)?
items.definition_used: Pairs = v0 grokking-region object and v1 grokking-v1 object with equal (p, train_frac, width, lr, wd, seed). Compared every TrainConfig field and task_cfg key, and train_loss, test_loss, train_acc, test_acc, param_norm at every evaluation step present in both light curves (exact equality). If all grid pairs coincide: v0 memorization runs on the grid whose v1 t_test_acc90 > 20,000, their v1 labels and the distribution of their v1 t_test_acc90.

Of 93 v0 memorization runs on the grid, 6 reach 90 % test accuracy after 20k in v1 (6 labelled grokking); v1 labels {'memorization': 70, 'smooth': 17, 'grokking': 6}; v1 t_test_acc90 of those: median 48718, range 39744-50000.
